item.title: Fuyukara, Kururu.
item.description:
ゲーム情報

  • ブランド: SILKY’S PLUS
  • 発売日: 2021-09-24
  • スコア: 7.49/10 (237 人評価)
  • 日本語名: ふゆから、くるる。
  • 英語名: Fuyukara, Kururu.

别名

  • ふゆくる

あらすじ

“Eh?

What do you mean that Shihon-chan might die?

Eeh? Shihon-chan’s head has gone missing?”

It seems Shihon-chan’s headless body was found in the meditation room.

A murder isn’t unusual, after all, there’s at least one bloodthirsty killer at school.

Murdering people is fine and all but it’s considered a taboo that must be never violated to decapitate and hide their head because one can never be revived if so.

item.title: Kanzume Shoujo no Shuumatsu Sekai
item.description:
ゲーム情報

  • ブランド: SILKY’S PLUS
  • 発売日: 2019-04-26
  • スコア: 7.05/10 (93 人評価)
  • 日本語名: 缶詰少女ノ終末世界
  • 英語名: Kanzume Shoujo no Shuumatsu Sekai

あらすじ

One day in early summer, Masataka took shelter from the torrential rain at the convenience store. While he waited for the rain to stop in the dine-in area, he noticed the girl beside him open a can of miso-flavoured mackerel and started to eat it. He was bewildered as she calmly walked out into the downpour while still eating it. Her eccentricity left a memory, and the next time he came across her, he asked her why she was eating the canned mackerel. In a long-winded response, she explained that it was in preparation for the end of the world. She was one of the ‘preppers’ and this was their story of how they faced the end of the world.
